- `VX_MASK_EXT`: The dimension of the voxel block [S1, unofficial].

The source text explicitly defines the formula for `mask_linear_idx` which includes the term `VX_MASK_EXT`. Specifically, the line `mask_linear_idx(coord) = local.x + local.y * VX_MASK_EXT + local.z * VX_MASK_EXT * VX_MASK_EXT` implies that `VX_MASK_EXT` is the stride or dimension size for the Y and Z axes in the linear indexing calculation. In the context of a 3D voxel block indexed linearly, this constant represents the dimension of the block along one axis (typically the side length of the cubic block). Therefore, the claim that `VX_MASK_EXT` represents the dimension of the voxel block is supported by the mathematical definition provided in the source.
